title: Ask about your data
lead: Anyone may ask what Aveline holds about their email address, or ask for it to be corrected or erased. You don’t need an account.

kind.EXPORT: A copy of what is held about me
kind.ERASURE: Erase what is held about me
kind.RECTIFICATION: Correct what is held about me

emailHelp: We’ll check it’s yours before answering.
notesHelp: For a correction, say what should change. Up to 2,000 characters.
sent: We’ve recorded your request. We’ll check who you are and answer by {{date}}, Yerevan time.
sameAnswer: This message is the same whether or not anything is held about that address.

errors.refused: The request wasn’t accepted. Check what you typed and try again.
